commentary.text: 90+11' The match has just finished.
90+10' What a chance that is! Vitaly Janelt swings the ball into the box, and Dango Ouattara (Brentford) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the left post.
90+8' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) meets a cross inside the box, but Caoimhin Kelleher wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
90+8' The resulting corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

90+7' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. The referee blows his whistle, Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
90+7' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
90+6' Great save! Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Caoimhin Kelleher.
90+5' Trey Nyoni (Liverpool) tackles a bit over-zealously and Darren England blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Brentford.
90+5' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren England had an easy-decision to make.
90+4' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.

90+2' CHANCE! Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a sublime shot towards the right side of the goal, but Caoimhin Kelleher produces an excellent save.
90+2' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+1' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
90' We will have 10 min. of added time.
89' Arne Slot has decided to substitute Ibrahima Konate and he is replaced by Joe Gomez (Liverpool).
89' It will be a substitution. Reiss Nelson (Brentford) is ready to enter the pitch as Keane Lewis-Potter walks off.
89' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
87' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

87' Milos Kerkez (Liverpool) is in the right place at the right time to receive a rebound and decides to shoot from long range, but his effort is immediately blocked. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
83' Substitution. Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) on for Mathias Jensen.
83' Here is a change. Andrew Robertson is going off and Arne Slot gives the last tactical orders to Milos Kerkez (Liverpool).
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Trey Nyoni (Liverpool) comes onto the pitch so that Ryan Gravenberch can be given a rest.
82' Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
81' Igor Thiago (Brentford) latches onto a short pass from Mathias Jensen inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the right post.
80' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal!
80' Having seen unsporting behavior, Darren England shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Jordan Henderson (Brentford) is the recipient.
79' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
79' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
78' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Darren England no option but to blow his whistle.
76' The game is interrupted now, Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
76' Kevin Schade (Brentford) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
74' Arne Slot decides to make a substitution. Mohamed Salah will be replaced by Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool).
73' A substitution has been made. Rio Ngumoha goes off and Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) comes on.
72' Mathias Jensen pings in the corner towards the centre of the box and finds Dango Ouattara (Brentford) unmarked, but his free header is woeful and slips well over the bar.
72' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) steps up to send the ball in.

71' Igor Thiago (Brentford) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag and Brentford will take a corner.
71' 18:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 5:2.
68' The referee blows for a cooling break.
66' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) attempts to find Mohamed Salah, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
66' Michael Kayode (Brentford) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
64' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Kevin Schade (Brentford) does well to meet a cross inside the box and produces a perfect header which goes low inside the left post.
63' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Caoimhin Kelleher has no trouble gathering it.
63' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out for a corner. Liverpool can continue in their attacking effort.
60' Substitution. Jordan Henderson makes way for Aaron Hickey (Brentford).
58' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Mohamed Salah is the provider as he slips the ball to Curtis Jones (Liverpool) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 1:0.
57' An attempted cross from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is cleared.
53' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
53' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
52' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Caoimhin Kelleher.
51' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
50' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

50' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
49' The resulting corner, taken by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool), comes to nothing.

49' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
46' Referee Darren England blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Jordan Henderson (Brentford) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
45+3' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45+1' Dango Ouattara (Brentford) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner with a short pass.
44' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. The ball is out of play. Liverpool win a corner kick.

43' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant. Liverpool earn a corner.

43' What an opportunity! Kevin Schade (Brentford) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the left side of the goal, but Alisson reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
41' CLOSE! Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the right post!
38' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

38' Caoimhin Kelleher is a nightmare for the offensive players! Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) meets a cross on the edge of the penalty area, takes a good first touch and fires a rocket of a shot towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper produces a wonderful save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Liverpool.
34' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

34' That's unlucky! Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Good work from Liverpool as they win a corner.
31' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
31' The total number of attempts is 8:1. 2:0 – this is the current number of shots on target.
30' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
28' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) sends a long cross over to Igor Thiago, but Alisson comes forward to gather the ball.

27' Mohamed Salah nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
23' A cooling break is underway.
22' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the right post.
21' A dangerous looking corner kick from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is cleared to safety by the defence.
20' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Caoimhin Kelleher intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.

19' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) fires in the free kick from a promising position just outside the box. It's a fantastic strike and looks set for glory, but it only rattles the left post! Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) pounced on a rebound on the edge of the box and his shot goes a whisker over the crossbar.
18' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Darren England signals. Liverpool earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
17' 66:34 – the latest ball possession ratio.
15' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
15' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
15' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Liverpool.
14' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
11' Igor Thiago (Brentford) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Dango Ouattara, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
11' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
8' Brentford seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
7' Keane Lewis-Potter crosses the ball right onto the head of Kevin Schade (Brentford), but his firm header from around the penalty spot shoots well wide of the right post.
7' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) commits a foul and Darren England immediately signals a free kick.
4' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His low header flies toward the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
4' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
4' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Liverpool force a corner. They send men into the box.
2' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Rio Ngumoha. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.

2' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
2' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
1' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Now Liverpool have a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Brentford will have the kick-off.
